description: Context rules for public information, media, news, and low-sensitivity content apps.

effect.appProfileImpact: For public-info apps, an unguarded exported provider usually needs a fix or explicit public API justification, but is not automatically escalated as a high-sensitivity data blocker.
For lower-sensitivity public-info apps, exported service/receiver surfaces are review items unless they handle auth, payment, or private user data.
For public-info apps, backup is usually not a blocker unless login, private user data, or tokens are in scope.
SDKs are shown as privacy/disclosure context for this lower-sensitivity profile.
